description: Network-based agent simulation of behavioral adoption diffusion with information spread, policy interventions, and adaptive social ties. Daily time steps over a contact network; adoption is driven by peer influence, information exposure, personal thresholds, and policy signals.

modules.name: NetworkBuilder
modules.description: Constructs and (optionally) dynamically updates the contact network and edge weights.

notes: Degree-preserving rewiring avoids large degree variance changes.
When using empirical network, dynamic rewiring still applies unless dynamic_rewiring_rate_daily=0.

modules.name: PolicyModule
modules.description: Generates policy signals for incentives, mandates, enforcement, and messaging over time, with optional equity targeting.

notes: Equity targeting affects downstream modules (BehaviorDecision, InformationDiffusion) by group-specific scaling, not the raw signals here.
enforcement_probability is treated as constant unless changed externally.

modules.name: InformationDiffusion
modules.description: Simulates exogenous information broadcasts and interpersonal transmission to produce per-agent exposure scores with decay.

notes: Awareness acts as a proxy for talking about the behavior.
Decay factor uses half-life, ensuring finite memory without hard cutoff.

modules.name: BehaviorDecision
modules.description: Updates individual adoption decisions using a noisy logistic rule combining peer adoption, exposure, thresholds, stubbornness, and policy signals; also models relapse.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == 0:
  initialize adoption for fraction initial_adopter_fraction at random, biased toward high awareness
  initialize awareness_i ~ Normal(initial_awareness_mean, 0.1), clipped [0,1]
  draw threshold_i ~ Normal(personal_threshold_mean, personal_threshold_sd), clipped [0,1]
  draw stubbornness_i ~ Beta(2, (2/stubbornness_mean)-2), clipped [0,1]
for each agent i:
  neighbor_influence = weighted_mean(adopted_neighbors, weights=edge_weight)  # in [0,1]
  effective_threshold = threshold_i / max(1e-6, heterogeneity_scaling)
  peer_term = peer_influence_weight * max(0, neighbor_influence - effective_threshold)
  exposure_term = exposure_weight * exposure_scores[i]
  policy_term = policy_incentive_weight * (signal.policy_incentive + signal.policy_mandate * signal.enforcement_probability)
  bias_term = base_adoption_bias - cost_of_adoption - stubbornness_i
  logit_p = bias_term + peer_term + exposure_term + policy_term + Normal(0, noise_scale_logit)
  p = sigmoid(logit_p)
  if not adopted_i and Bernoulli(p):
    adopted_i = True; day_of_first_adoption = t; new_adoptions += 1
  else if adopted_i and Bernoulli(relapse_probability_daily * (1 - signal.policy_mandate)):
    adopted_i = False; relapses += 1
update awareness_i = min(1, awareness_i + 0.1*adopted_i + 0.01*neighbor_influence)
emit signal.adoption_state, signal.new_adoptions, signal.relapses
notes: Logistic decision allows smooth probability rather than hard threshold.
Equity targeting is applied as: if equity_targeting_enabled and income_group == 'low', multiply policy_term by targeting_priority_low_income_weight.

modules.name: TieRewiring
modules.description: Adoption-status-driven social rewiring with homophily and triadic closure, subject to degree caps.

notes: This module focuses on adoption-status homophily; demographic assortativity handled in NetworkBuilder.
Edge weights for new ties use NetworkBuilder's parameters.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates adoption and network statistics into observables for calibration and evaluation.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate = mean(adopted)
new_adoptions_daily = sum(new_adoptions)
cumulative_adoption = cumulative sum of new_adoptions over time divided by N
adoption_rate_low = mean(adopted for income_group == 'low')
adoption_rate_high = mean(adopted for income_group == 'high')
adoption_gap_income = adoption_rate_high - adoption_rate_low
network_clustering = average_clustering(signal.network)
apply moving average with window smoothing_window_days to adoption_rate and new_adoptions if report_frequency_days == 1
emit all observables
notes: Smoothing can be disabled by setting smoothing_window_days=1.

initialization.network_setup: Use NetworkBuilder parameters to generate or load network at t=0. Assign demographics using age_share_* and income_share_*; draw thresholds, stubbornness, and awareness; set initial adopters according to initial_adopter_fraction.

algorithms.WeightedThresholdLogit: Noisy logistic adoption probability combining peer adoption above personal threshold, exposure, policy incentives/mandates, and individual traits.
algorithms.IndependentCascadeWithDecay: Information diffusion with per-edge transmission probability and exponential decay of exposure memory.
algorithms.AssortativeRewiring: Degree-preserving rewiring favoring homophily on adoption status and demographics, with optional triadic closure.
algorithms.MovingAggregation: Rolling-window smoothing and cumulative sums to produce daily observables.
